intended_behavior: Add explicit calls to agent.conversation_manager.apply_management(agent) at suitable points during invocation or event handling to perform conversation message pruning dynamically and prevent message bloat during execution. This integration is necessary despite the procedural code structure.

Clarify that for the standard agent, manual invocation of apply_management inside AfterInvocationEvent hooks is redundant due to internal agent calls. Encourage proper integration of conversation management calls within specialized or experimental agent loops rather than relying on custom hooks for message pruning.
